description: Implement all 13 audit fixes from the original PR #206, re-based on the current main which includes PR #205 chat-resilience patterns. The chat.py refactoring into ChatService MUST preserve all asyncio.wait_for timeout wrapping, granular error handling, graceful Redis degradation, and OTel tracing from the current version.
steps: DEP-01: Migrate python-jose to PyJWT. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py: change 'from jose import jwt, JWTError' to 'import jwt; from jwt.exceptions import PyJWTError' (use PyJWTError instead of JWTError). Update all jwt.encode() calls to use jwt.encode(payload, secret, algorithm=alg) and jwt.decode() to use jwt.decode(token, secret, algorithms=[alg]). Same change in apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin.py. In apps/backend/tests/test_admin_endpoints.py: update 'from jose import jwt' to 'import jwt'. Remove 'python-jose' from apps/backend/requirements.in (keep 'pyjwt'). NOTE: PyJWT's jwt.encode returns a string directly (no .decode() needed). PyJWT raises jwt.ExpiredSignatureError and jwt.InvalidTokenError instead of JWTError.
CICD-02: In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml, .github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml, and .github/workflows/ci-edge.yml: replace all '--no-frozen-lockfile' with '--frozen-lockfile'.

SEC-05: In apps/backend/app/core/security.py sanitize_user_input(): (a) Add unicodedata import and apply NFKC normalization as first step: text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text). (b) Strip zero-width characters: text = re.sub(r'[\u200b-\u200f\u2028-\u202f\u2060\ufeff]', '', text). (c) Expand injection_patterns to also include: r'\[INST\]', r'<\|system\|>', r'<\|user\|>', r'<\|assistant\|>', r'END OF PROMPT', r'IGNORE ABOVE'.

ARCH-06: Refactor apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py into a ChatService class. Extract business logic into class ChatService with methods: __init__(self), async check_rate_limit(...), async process_chat(...), async process_stream(...). Keep the router thin (router functions just parse request, call ChatService methods, return response). CRITICAL: preserve ALL existing patterns from the current file: asyncio.wait_for timeout wrapping in the POST / endpoint, granular error handling (RuntimeError with embedding/search/timeout classification, httpx.HTTPStatusError, asyncio.TimeoutError, ValueError, generic Exception), graceful Redis degradation in rate limiting, helper functions _resolve_lang_and_model, _build_system_prompt, _save_chat_async, OTel tracing spans in the stream endpoint, Sarvam->Vertex fallback, fire-and-forget persistence, PostHog tracking. The ChatService class should be instantiated as a module-level singleton.

SEC-07: In apps/backend/app/core/security.py: make is_safe_url async. Replace synchronous socket.getaddrinfo with asyncio.getaddrinfo (asyncio.get_event_loop().getaddrinfo or asyncio.getaddrinfo). Wrap DNS resolution in asyncio.wait_for with a 3-second timeout. On timeout, return False (treat as unsafe).

CICD-04: In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml: add a new job 'trivy-scan' after 'ci-checks' and before the deploy jobs. Use aquasecurity/trivy-action@master to scan the built Docker image. It should run after the 'Build & Push to ACR' step in deploy-backend, or as a separate job that builds locally. Simplest approach: add a step in deploy-backend after the ACR build that runs trivy with exit-code 1 on CRITICAL severity.

PERF-04: In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py: add Redis caching for search results. Before executing the Azure search, check Redis for a cached result using a hash of (query + user_tier + limit) as key. Cache results with a 5-minute TTL. Use the get_redis() pattern from app.db.redis. Handle Redis failures gracefully (log warning, proceed without cache).

CFG-03: In apps/edge/wrangler.toml: add a comment block above the ISR_CACHE_KV binding explaining the placeholder IDs and setup instructions: 'Before production deploy: 1. npx wrangler kv:namespace create ISR_CACHE_KV, 2. npx wrangler kv:namespace create ISR_CACHE_KV --preview, 3. Replace placeholder-isr-cache-kv-id and placeholder-isr-cache-kv-preview-id with actual IDs.'

PERF-05: Add Redis caching for conversation history in the _load_conversation_history function in chat.py (or ChatService). Cache the last 5 turns per session_id with a 30-minute TTL in Redis. On cache hit, return cached history. On cache miss, load from MongoDB and store in cache. Handle Redis failures gracefully (fall back to direct MongoDB read).

TEST-06: Add edge worker tests for rate-limit.ts, cors.ts, and bot.ts in apps/edge/tests/. Follow the pattern from apps/edge/tests/jwt.test.ts (vitest, describe/it/expect). For rate-limit.ts: test checkRateLimit allows/blocks at limit, test rateLimitHeaders output. For cors.ts: test getCorsHeaders with valid/invalid origins, test applyCorsHeaders. For bot.ts: test turnstileVerify with mocked fetch (success/failure).

ARCH-08: Refactor apps/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx by extracting reusable hooks into separate files: (a) Create apps/frontend/src/hooks/useTokenManager.js - extract _storeToken, _storeRefreshToken, getInMemoryToken logic. (b) Create apps/frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRefresh.js - extract the silent refresh logic from fetchMe. (c) Create apps/frontend/src/hooks/useAnonSync.js - extract the anonymous data claim effect. The AuthContext.jsx should import and use these hooks, keeping the context provider lean.

DEP-05: The .github/dependabot.yml already exists with correct configuration. Verify it covers pip (backend), npm (root, frontend, edge), and github-actions ecosystems. If already complete, no changes needed.

CICD-05: In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml: add comments documenting each KeyVault secret reference in the 'Fetch secrets from Azure KeyVault' step. For each secret, add a comment explaining what it's used for (e.g., '# JWT signing key for access/refresh tokens', '# MongoDB Atlas connection string', etc.).
acceptance_criteria: No imports of 'jose' remain in backend Python files (replaced with PyJWT)
All CI workflows use --frozen-lockfile instead of --no-frozen-lockfile
security.py sanitize_user_input uses NFKC normalization, strips zero-width chars, has expanded patterns
security.py is_safe_url is async with asyncio-based DNS resolution and 3s timeout
chat.py has a ChatService class encapsulating business logic while preserving ALL PR #205 resilience patterns (asyncio.wait_for, granular error handling, Redis graceful degradation, OTel tracing)
azure_search.py has Redis caching with 5-min TTL
Conversation history has Redis caching with 30-min TTL
Edge tests exist for rate-limit.ts, cors.ts, bot.ts
AuthContext.jsx is refactored with extracted hooks
deploy-all.yml has KeyVault secret documentation comments
verification: grep -r 'from jose' apps/backend/ returns no results
grep 'async def is_safe_url' apps/backend/app/core/security.py returns a match
grep 'class ChatService' apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py returns a match
grep 'wait_for' apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py returns a match (resilience preserved)
